title: Jewellery Company for Sale in Bangkok, Thailand
tagline: Located in Bangkok, this is a fully integrated jewelry manufacturing and e-commerce business ready for takeover. - We specialize in creating stunning sterling silver, gold, gemstone, and diamond jewelry with a focus on in-house production. - The business generates high revenue with a lean team of 10 employees through in-house manufacturing, reusable master molds, streamlined production processes, and global direct-to-consumer sales via our website, Amazon, Etsy, and Shopify. - With a manufacturing capacity of 2,000 pieces a month, there's potential to boost that to 10,000 as we scale up. - Our unique designs and intellectual property make us stand out in the market. - We sell globally, tapping into major markets like North America and Europe through platforms like Amazon, Etsy, and our own Shopify store. - This business presents excellent opportunities for growth and profitability, thanks to our integrated approach to manufacturing and direct sales. - You'll get all the perks of established international channels, making it easier to serve consumers worldwide. - The business operates with a valid registration certificate.
